settings.debugLoggingLocked: On while packet logging is on: packet logs need the debug log to be read.

tips.characterName: Your in-game name and ID, so the meter knows which row is you. It is usually found on its own.
tips.device: The network connection the meter reads game traffic from. Auto-detect finds it; pick one by hand if you use a VPN.
tips.lockedPort: The adapter and port the game was found on.
tips.defaultMeterMode: The target mode the meter opens in: Boss, Target, Train or All.
tips.playerLimit: How many player rows the meter shows; the rest are left out.
tips.pinMeToTop: Your row stays first, whatever your damage.
tips.autoHideMeter: The meter disappears while another window is in front of the game, and comes back with it.
tips.detailsMonitor: Opens the Details window on the chosen display and keeps it there.
tips.showTtk: Beside the battle timer, an estimate of how long the whole boss fight will take.
tips.showTotalDps: A bar under the rows with the party's combined DPS and damage.
tips.showSuspendBtn: A button on the meter that stops reading game traffic until you press it again.
tips.showLockBtn: A button that makes the meter ignore the mouse, so clicks go through to the game.
tips.windowOpacity: How see-through the meter's background is. Bars and text stay as they are.
tips.meterOpacity: How solid the coloured damage bars are.
tips.meterSaturation: How strong the bars' colours are: lower for softer, higher for more vivid.
tips.bossNameSize: Size of the boss or target name above the bars.
tips.partyStat: The number beside each player's name, in the meter and in Details. Only your own party's members have one.
tips.barTexture: A pattern over the meter's bars. A thank-you for supporting A2 Tools.
tips.textureOffset: Each bar starts its texture at a different place, so the bars don't all look alike.
tips.trainingMode: In Train mode, which dummies the Details window shows: all of them together, or only the one you hit hardest.
tips.allTargetsWindow: In All Targets mode, the meter adds up every target hit within this time of the latest hit.
tips.updateRate: How often the meter's numbers refresh. Faster shows hits sooner but uses more CPU.
tips.debugLogging: Writes a diagnostic log the developer can use to track down problems.
tips.saveRawPackets: Records raw game traffic for bug reports. Debug logging turns on with it.
tips.globalHotkeys: The keys below work anywhere, even while the game is in front. Off, they are released for other programs. On Linux your desktop registers them and may ask you to approve them.
tips.pluginDevMode: Loads plugins from folders on this computer, for building and testing them. They are not reviewed, so only load plugins you trust.

hotkeyConsent.desktop: On Linux, your desktop sets up keybinds for the meter, and it may ask you to approve them.
hotkeyConsent.anytime: You can turn keybinds off at any time.

npcapPrompt.ask:
A2Tools DPS Meter needs Npcap to read the game's network traffic, and Npcap is missing or not working.

Install it now? The meter downloads Npcap's installer from npcap.com and opens it. Once Npcap is installed, the meter starts capturing by itself.

Choose No to install it yourself from https://npcap.com/#download
npcapPrompt.downloadFailed:
Npcap's installer could not be downloaded ({error}).

Install it yourself from https://npcap.com/#download, then open the meter again.
npcapPrompt.stillMissing: Npcap is still not working. If its installer was closed before it finished, install Npcap from https://npcap.com/#download, then open the meter again.
